propositions: Package-free by-path load of reconcile.py raises ModuleNotFoundError when _commit_binding_store_snapshot() executes an unconditional top-level import of rebar_reconciler.git_adapter at reconcile_helpers.py:200
Standalone reconcile.py loads reconcile_helpers under a flat key without creating an importable parent package, causing the import to fail before reaching the no-state True branch and fail-open catch

The helper must resolve git_adapter through the existing sibling loader using canonical key rebar_reconciler.git_adapter to restore package-free execution while preserving cache identity and documented True/False/error semantics

Commit d9e0f0e733 replaced package-independent subprocess calls with the unconditional import, breaking the explicitly supported standalone contract documented in reconcile_helpers.py:10-16,30-46 and reconcile.py:20-36,51-58
